_comment: Update after each Fed / ECB rate decision. 'stance' is your read of the last statement's tone: hawkish, neutral, or dovish. Next meeting dates keep this from going stale silently.

USD.rate_note: Upper bound of target range, currently 3.50-3.75%
USD.stance_note: Holding steady but flagged inflation/energy risk (Iran conflict); one cut still projected later in 2026 but timing uncertain

EUR.rate_note: Deposit facility rate, hiked 25bps from 2.00% effective 2026-06-17
EUR.stance_note: Actively tightening due to energy-driven inflation shock; 2026 headline inflation projected at 3%

CAD.rate_note: Overnight rate target, held steady for 6 consecutive decisions
CAD.stance_note: Holding steady; growth improving but energy-driven inflation risk from Middle East conflict keeps a hawkish bias in play without active tightening yet

GBP.rate_note: Bank Rate, held steady in a 7-2 vote on 2026-06-18 (2 dissents favored a hike to 4.00%)
GBP.stance_note: Holding but hawkish-leaning; services inflation rising (3.7%) keeps a hike on the table, Middle East conflict adding energy-driven inflation risk

JPY.rate_note: Policy rate, hiked 25bps from 0.75% effective 2026-06-17 — highest in 31 years
JPY.stance_note: Actively normalizing; yen weakness (near 40-year low) adding inflation risk, officials reportedly open to hiking faster than consensus expects
